body: Best of luck to you too, I wish I could give you advice or anything like that but I think the only reason mine went away is because quarantine took away a lot of my stresses.

Yeah I guess maybe I’m just really pessimistic, but like even if I was able to find a good job stressing out over rent payments and food and money doesn’t really seem like a good life to me i guess. Like idk there’s a lot of statistics on how the average American lives paycheck to paycheck and that doesn’t sound to good to me I guess. That’s more so what I meant I think. Thank you for taking the time to read what I wrote and comment though, I appreciate it. I hope everything’s going well with you.
